2116801700564726233.en_summary: Binance says withdrawals are now restored for $ETH, $USDT and $USDC on Ethereum and for $BNB, $USDT and $USDC on BNB Smart Chain. Quoted that all withdrawals will now be processed from newly generated wallet addresses added to its proof of reserves.
2116801700564726233.zh_summary: Binance表示現已恢復以太坊網絡上的$ETH、$USDT和$USDC以及BNB智能鏈上的$BNB、$USDT和$USDC提款。引用稱所有提款現將從新增至其儲備證明的新生成錢包地址處理。

2116799757507305516.en_summary: (Reposted by @cz_binance) Binance Withdrawal Update: withdrawals have now been restored for Ethereum Network USDC, USDT, ETH and BNB Smart Chain (BSC) USDC, USDT, BNB. Will continue to restore additional assets and networks in phases after security checks. Quoted that first batch network opened in phase one is $BTC bitcoin network.
2116799757507305516.zh_summary: （由@cz_binance轉發）Binance提款更新：現已恢復以太坊網絡USDC、USDT、ETH以及BNB智能鏈（BSC）USDC、USDT、BNB的提款。將在完成安全檢查後分階段繼續恢復其他資產和網絡。引用稱第一階段開放的第一批網絡是$BTC比特幣網絡。

2116791881057354102.en_summary: (Reposted by @cz_binance) Yi He says things are currently running fairly smoothly. If there are many withdrawal requests, congestion cannot be ruled out, after which it will smooth out again. Before withdrawing, carefully check the address and confirm security of any new device and environment. Safety first. Quoted Binance update on first batch $BTC network.
2116791881057354102.zh_summary: （由@cz_binance轉發）Yi He表示目前運作相當順利。如果提款請求很多，不排除出現擁堵，之後會再次順暢。提款前請仔細檢查地址並確認任何新設備和環境的安全。安全第一。引用Binance關於第一批$BTC網絡的更新。

2116810790246215720.en_summary: David Gokhshtein thinks Satoshi’s Bitcoin should be left alone. Acknowledges concern about quantum attacks but argues that debating whether someone should be allowed to spend their own Bitcoin contradicts permissionless money and eliminating middlemen. Coins aren't ours to control regardless if Satoshi is alive or dead; freezing them sets a bad precedent for others.
2116810790246215720.zh_summary: David Gokhshtein認為Satoshi的比特幣應該被放任不管。他承認對量子攻擊的擔憂，但認為辯論是否應允許某人花費自己的比特幣，與無許可金錢和去除中間人的理念相矛盾。無論Satoshi是否健在，這些硬幣都不是我們可以控制的；凍結它們會為他人設定不良先例。

2116807559059513619.en_summary: JPM says AI capex to rise from $900B to $1.5-2T in '27. The current cycle is NOT analogous to the dot-com boom, when speculative investment ran ahead of demand.
2116807559059513619.zh_summary: JPM表示AI資本支出將從2027年的9000億美元上升至1.5-2萬億美元。當前週期並非類似於互聯網泡沫時期，當時投機性投資跑在需求前面。

ticker_notes.JPM: 引用JPM對AI資本支出大幅上升的預測，並認為當前週期不同於互聯網泡沫
